Title: Jenna Cross + Salvador Garcia specials question

Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
How much blood will an anarch requiring card normally costing 1 blood cost for Jenna to play if I control both Her and Salvador?
a) 1 blood, special cancel each other out.
b) 0 blood, Salvador's special can be applied first reducing cost to 0 at which point, Jenna's special won't trigger anymore
c) something weird

Jenna Cross
[pot]

[CEL]
[Caitiff] Caitiff
Capacity: 4
Group: 4
Independent anarch: Cards that cost blood cost Jenna 1 additional blood to play. Sterile.

Salvador Garcia
[pot]
[pro]
[CEL]

[Brujah] Brujah
Capacity: 7
Group: 4
Independent anarch: While Salvador is ready, cards requiring an anarch cost you and anarchs you control 1 less blood or pool.

Messages.Author: Kimpan
Messages.Body:
I would say 0, have no good backup for it but it feels like you should be the one to decide what effekt take place first because they are happening at the same time and you are the acting vampire.

But some rule guru can probably give you a better anser.

National Coordinator of Sweden

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
You apply the effects in the order of your choosing, so you can apply Salvador's effect first, making the card cost 0, then Jenna's (no additional blood).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
Per www.vekn.net/history-of-vtes-rules/450-rules-team-rulings-7-july-2007, are you reading that "addition and subtraction" as a group that can be ordered or an ordering?

I've always read it as the latter. Which meant that you had to handle the addition first, then the subtraction.

This seems to assert that the items are a grouping and within that grouping may be handled in any order.

Could you please clarify how the 7/7/07 RTR works?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> kschaefer wrote:
> Per www.vekn.net/history-of-vtes-rules/450-rules-team-rulings-7-july-2007, are you reading that "addition and subtraction" as a group that can be ordered or an ordering?
>
> I've always read it as the latter. Which meant that you had to handle the addition first, then the subtraction.
>
> This seems to assert that the items are a grouping and within that grouping may be handled in any order.
>
> Could you please clarify how the 7/7/07 RTR works?
>
You apply the "multiplication/division" group first, then "addition/substraction" group.
Within each group, you (as the acting Methuselah) choose in which order you apply each modifier. Usually it doesn't matter, except for Jenna Cross.

I don't read it as "... followed by addition then subtraction."

I still have to check the Sword of Nuln / Regenerative Blood ruling though.

EDIT : Since Regenerative Blood doesn't use multiplication or division, it changes nothing to the ruling I gave. But if somehow you had a Thin-Blooded Seer with an Ankara Citadel, you could choose whether you halve the cost first or not.
